reviews.title: Is this what humans think that humans like?
reviews.text: I had to subscribe after the trial of one sound I liked and the rest are garbage. No email, no website for feedback. I thought I was paying for good sleep brain wave sounds. Nope. They all sound like either a computer is deciding what humans like or like a 90s Walmart CD with a lot of flutes.

reviews.text: Don’t trick people into thinking this is a free app when you charge $480 for literal rain noises. There is no world where this app should cost more than music streaming.

reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.text:
I would like to update AFTER the product developers response. I’ve used the app for a few months now because it does have A LOT of free options. However the issue I have is not with the fact it’s a subscription. It’s the fact that when you find a sleep option that works with your sleep pattern, brain, etc. when you find what you’re looking for in the free options and you use it for 3 weeks to a month the sound that works for you falls into the “subscription part”, because someone is monitoring the app and realized a specific track is being frequently utilized. That’s the problem. The developers try to FORCE you into a subscription. 

Just another subscription, the longer you listen to the same sound they add that free sound to the subscription only options. Even if it started out free to begin with.

reviews.title: No subscription notification
reviews.text: The app isn’t bad however, it gave me an option for a notification 2 days before my free trial ended, which  didn’t receive and now I’ve had to pay 37.99 to an app I’m not going to use again. Very disappointed

reviews.title: Basically a Scam
reviews.text:
If you need white noise, find something else.

I downloaded this app while away from my usual white noise source on vacation. I just wanted the free trial, and checked an option to get a reminder to cancel before the trial period was up. I never received the reminder, and naturally I forgot to cancel. I then got charged $45 for a year membership all at once. After emailing support and following up, I have yet to receive a response a week later. This is clearly set up to encourage people to download for a trial and then get charged for a full year subscription up front. Totally scammy and manipulative - do yourself a favor and stay away.
